summary: One-frame result of (un)subscribing to a mod on mod.io (client only, registry total 16). ls::PublishingSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3BDE2A0; Toolkit GameEngine.dll ls::PublishingSystem::Process*Requests) creates it on a new entity from a request queued by the matching HandleUGC... callback of the mod.io back-end; the same frame also gets a UGCRequestResultOneFrameComponent with the net::UGCResult and request Guid. Request queue filled by HandleUGCItemSubscribed / HandleUGCItemUnsubscribed(unsigned __int64, net::UGCResult); drained by bg3.exe+0x3BDF080.

fields.name: ModId
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x3BE15A0 (AllocRaw 0x10) zeroes +0; bg3.exe+0x3BDF080 stores the request's qword +0 (mod id; request stride 0x48).

fields.name: Subscribed
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes byte +8; bg3.exe+0x3BDF080 copies request byte +0x30, which HandleUGCItemSubscribed (bg3.exe+0x3BE0840) sets to 1 and HandleUGCItemUnsubscribed (bg3.exe+0x3BE0920) to 0.
